title: Black & White Family Portrait Colorization
prompt_text: Restore and colorize this black-and-white family portrait. Preserve facial features, hairstyle, clothing details, and original composition exactly. Add period-accurate colors for [decade, e.g., 1950s]: warm skin tones, era-correct fabric colors, soft daylight. Remove scratches, dust, and fading. Output: ultra-high clarity, realistic skin texture, natural shadows, archival quality.

title: Vintage Travel Photo Color Recovery
prompt_text: Colorize this vintage travel photograph from approximately [year]. Apply era-accurate colors: muted sky tones, period-correct vehicle paint, natural foliage greens, weathered architecture colors. Preserve original composition, all people's identities, and clothing patterns exactly. Light denoise, mild sharpen, no AI hallucination of new objects.

title: Old Wedding Photo Period Color
prompt_text: Restore and colorize this vintage wedding photograph. Bride's dress: keep original off-white/ivory tone of the era. Skin tones: natural warm flesh, no over-saturation. Background: era-accurate venue colors. Preserve every guest's face, posture, and clothing exactly. Remove staining and edge damage. Output ultra-high clarity, archival print quality.

title: Heavy Scratch & Tear Repair
prompt_text: Restore this damaged photograph. Remove all scratches, tears, dust, water stains, and edge fraying while preserving every facial feature, clothing detail, and background element exactly as in the original. Do not reinterpret or modernize subjects. Maintain original tonal balance, grain structure, and photographic medium. Output: clean restoration with archival fidelity.

title: Water Damage Recovery
prompt_text: Recover this water-damaged photograph. Remove water stains, mold marks, color bleeding, and surface buckling. Preserve subject identity, expression, posture, and original color palette. Reconstruct only the obviously damaged areas using contextual clues from undamaged regions. Do not invent new details. Output: restored image with realistic continuity.

title: Folded Crease Removal
prompt_text: Remove fold creases and surface scratches from this photograph. Reconstruct the missing pixel data along the crease lines using the surrounding image content. Preserve subject pose, facial details, clothing texture, and background composition exactly. Maintain the original photo's tone, contrast, and medium-specific texture. No facial smoothing or modernization.

title: Grandparent Modern Studio Quality
prompt_text: Restore and modernize this old portrait of a grandparent. Preserve facial identity, hairstyle, expression, clothing, and posture exactly. Enhance to studio-quality: sharp focus on the eyes, natural skin texture with realistic pores and micro-details, balanced soft daylight, neutral background. Remove damage, fading, and noise. Output: a portrait suitable for a framed family memorial print.

title: Childhood Photo HD Restoration
prompt_text: Restore this childhood photograph to high-definition print quality. Preserve every facial feature, expression, clothing detail, and toy or prop exactly as in the original. Enhance clarity, recover missing micro-details, and balance lighting naturally. Maintain era-correct color palette and warm nostalgic tone. Output: HD restoration suitable for archival album printing.

title: Low-Res Scan to 4K
prompt_text: Upscale this low-resolution scan to 4K crisp clarity. Preserve all original content: faces, expressions, clothing, background details, and color palette must remain identical. Enhance edge sharpness, recover natural skin texture, and reduce film grain only where it harms readability. Do not introduce new objects, change lighting direction, or alter subject identity.

title: iPhone Camera-of-Photo Enhance
prompt_text: Enhance this smartphone-camera photograph of a printed photograph. Remove glare reflections, perspective distortion, and screen-of-photo moiré patterns. Recover the underlying photograph as if professionally scanned: corrected geometry, even lighting, no glare, full tonal range. Preserve all original photographic content and color palette exactly.

title: Preserve Sepia Tone Sharpen
prompt_text: Sharpen and enhance this sepia-toned vintage photograph while preserving its warm sepia color palette and antique character. Remove scratches and dust. Recover lost details in shadows and highlights. Maintain the original photographic medium's grain structure and tonal warmth. Do not colorize. Output: sharp, well-preserved sepia print quality.

title: Faded Color Restoration Era-Accurate
prompt_text: Restore this faded color photograph from approximately [decade]. Recover original color saturation using era-accurate reference: typical [decade] film stocks (Kodachrome / Ektachrome / Fujichrome) and their characteristic color shifts. Preserve all subjects, clothing patterns, and composition exactly. Remove minor scratches and color casts. Output: vibrant restoration faithful to the original era's photographic look.
